## Source: amazon-inspector (8ee5547a9548aa8d9a79a6b9b8a8ded3a27c1164c780957ce31645c39253ec04)
Package declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs index.js on npm install. The script collects os.hostname(), os.platform(), and os.arch() and POSTs them to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain at fundraiserservicepp.rpke7za0zz1pwj9fz5058j0y5pbgz82wr.oastify.com/hit. This is a dependency-confusion beacon pattern: installing the package automatically leaks internal host identifiers from the installer's build environment to an attacker-controlled out-of-band domain.

## Source: ossf-package-analysis (cefb4588a67439c112176df4b9af71d40a1e2a12e0bf81ef200affa79e0cb0e0)
The OpenSSF Package Analysis project identified 'fundraiserservicepp' @ 1.5.0 (npm) as malicious.

It is considered malicious because:

- The package communicates with a domain associated with malicious activity.
